The '''Misty Falls''' were waterfalls located on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:MF" /> It consisted of two waterfalls: the '''Greater Misty Falls''' and the '''Lesser Misty Falls'''.<ref name="SWG:GMF">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Badge: "Greater Misty Falls"}}</ref><ref name="SWG:LMF">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Badge: "Lesser Misty Falls"}}</ref>

It was the center of the [[Misty Falls Clan]] of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Omogg]] sent a representative to Dathomir in order to explore the planet. The latter recruited adventurous [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to brave the planet's dangerous wilds and record [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of specific point of interests, including the Misty Falls.<ref name="SWG:W" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Misty Falls appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
